title: Average Operator
description: Learn to calculate the average of numeric values using the Average operator.

data.text: The `Average` extension method calculates the average of numeric items in a collection. It returns a nullable or non-nullable decimal, double, or float value.

data.title: Average Examples
Average with Complex Types
Not Supported in Query Syntax
data.text: The Average operator is not supported in C# query syntax. Use method syntax only.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Average calculates the average of numeric items
